# `MC_knlSetTimer`

Schedule a previously defined timer with a 64-bit timeout and callback parameter.

## Prototype

```c
M_Int32 MC_knlSetTimer(MCTimer *tm, M_Int64 timeout, void *parm);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_knlSetTimer
:project: libwipi
```

## Usage

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tm` | Timer initialized with MC_knlDefTimer. |
| `timeout` | WIPI timeout value passed as a 64-bit integer. |
| `parm` | Opaque value delivered to the timer callback. |

### Return value

The provider-defined result code.

### Notes

- libwipi uses a tested ABI veneer because the observed Samsung/KTF provider packs the 64-bit timeout differently from an AAPCS caller.
